items.title: Unit 1 · Story
items.scene: The man puts ___ on the yam for the ants.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: The man puts jam on the yam for the ants.
items.storyText: A man with a van is at the dam. He has a fan, a can, and a yam. The ants want the yam! The man puts jam on the yam for the ants.
items.why: In “Ants”, you hear: The man puts jam on the yam for the ants. The missing word is “jam”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 2, Unit 1, p.11 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
